claims.statement: HubSpot's OAuth token documentation describes a refresh token as the app's long-term credential that generates a new access token after the previous one expires.

sources.supports: Refresh token: your app's long-term authentication credential that you can use to generate a new access token after the previous one expires.

claims.statement: HubSpot's OAuth token endpoint (POST /oauth/2026-09/token) returns the refresh token as a refresh_token member of the JSON token response beside access_token, token_type, hub_id, scopes and expires_in, and takes it as the refresh_token field of the URL-form encoded request body of a refresh request (grant_type refresh_token, with client_id and client_secret); the introspection request takes it as the refresh_token and token fields.

sources.supports: In the response, you’ll receive the access token along with the refresh token, which you can use to refresh the access token. (the example response JSON has the members token_type, refresh_token, access_token, hub_id, scopes and expires_in)

Using a refresh token, you can generate a new access token by making a URL-form encoded POST request to /oauth/2026-09/token. In the request body, you’ll specify the grant_type, client_id, client_secret, and refresh_token.
refresh_token | String | The refresh token value.
refresh_token | String | If you specified refresh_token as the token_type_hint, then provide the refresh_token as an additional property in your request.

openQuestions.question: This candidate is not researched beyond existence: the pages read name the credential but state no literal prefix, alphabet, length or checksum, and no format is recorded or inferred.
No format statement for refresh tokens appears in the page read; placeholder values in examples are not a format.

The member and request field are documented by the 2026-09 token page read on 2026-10-05; its example refresh token is a placeholder value the page does not state as a format, so no prefix, alphabet or width is recorded.
The page says the v1 endpoints passed parameters as query parameters; the v1 request layout was not read and is not recorded.
